description: Find exchange listings by company name or ticker (query), by ISIN (isin), or list every listing of one exchange or country, across the US and other exchanges. Each row gives the symbol other tools accept (a bare ticker for a US listing, MIC:TICKER such as XETR:SIE for another exchange), the company, country, trading currency, ISIN, security type and whether it is the company's main listing. An ISIN returns every listing of that security, each in its own currency; a US or Canadian ISIN also matches a US listing by its CUSIP. Use ListExchanges for the exchange and country codes.

exchange.description: Exchange code to keep or list (e.g. XETR, XAMS, XLIS); see ListExchanges.

isin.description: ISIN to look up (e.g. IE00B5BMR087); not combined with query.

market.description: Country code whose listings to list (e.g. US, DE, PT); used on its own.

offset.description: Rows to skip before returning results (default 0).

query.description: Company name or ticker to search for (e.g. siemens, ASML, XETR:SIE).
